release_scope: non-destructive MiniMax H3 final-format gate and dialogue clarity repair
changes: Added a final H3 format gate that validates fields, real reference labels, shot headers, dialogue bindings, global sound sentence limits, and Ref2VA word minimums without deleting creative or engineering detail.
Added local speaker-to-speech binding checks and explicit intelligibility, mouth-sync, pause, emphasis, breath, direction, and action-noise masking instructions.
Preserved engineering parameters, combat timing, spatial facts, camera paths, continuity, STYLE_MOTHER, and all existing production ownership boundaries.
Recompiled authored example H3 files so generated exports match the repaired compiler output.
known_limits: The format gate proves prompt structure and literal dialogue binding; it cannot guarantee generated audio will be intelligible without listening to real media.
Automatic file batching and prompt execution still depend on the host workspace, tools, permissions, context budget, disk capacity, and runtime limits.
